value.rationale: Despite clear motivation, the surviving mathematics consists of direct coordinate/scaling identities, an elementary normalized-distance observation, and a zero-swirl test-field construction that is not a Navier–Stokes solution. It does not establish a substantive PDE boundary theorem, actual blow-up mechanism, compactness obstruction beyond the tautological escaping-center issue, or new invariant; under the stated bar this is too routine to qualify.

final_claim: On-axis scaling preserves axisymmetry and Gamma exactly; under axis-projected peak normalization the peak has rescaled radius d_k=r_k M_k, bounded Gamma alone gives no kinematic bound on d_k, and Type-II rates give arbitrarily long backward windows.
limitations: No actual Navier–Stokes blow-up with d_k to infinity is constructed.
Bounded d_k removes only this geometric escape issue; analytic compactness/nontriviality still require separate proof.
